SELECT t.* FROM (SELECT arh.document_number, ( SELECT hbm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = arh.bp_id ) bp_name, arh.receipt_date, arh.total_amount, arh.receipt_type, (case when arh.receipt_type = 'LEASEBACK_PRINCIPAL' then '回租本金' else '保证金/风险金' end)receipt_type_n, arh.receipt_hd_id, arh.bp_id, ( SELECT DISTINCT hci.description FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc, hls_cashflow_item hci, acr_receipt_ln arl WHERE arl.source_id = ccc.cashflow_id AND hci.cf_item = ccc.cf_item AND arl.receipt_hd_id = arh.receipt_hd_id ) cf_item_desc, ( SELECT fc.company_full_name FROM fnd_company fc WHERE fc.company_id = arh.company_id ) company_name, TABALL1.name business_name, TABALL1.unit_name business_unit, arh.receipt_status, (case when arh.receipt_status ='PRINT' then '已打印' else '未打印' end) receipt_status_n FROM acr_receipt_hd arh left join (SELECT FE.NAME, SUA.USER_ID, FOU.UNIT_ID, MIN(FOU.UNIT_NAME) UNIT_NAME, SUA.COMPANY_ID FROM SYS_USER_ALLOCATION SUA LEFT JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS FEA ON SUA.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID = FEA.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID LEFT JOIN FND_ORG_UNIT FOU ON FEA.UNIT_ID = FOU.UNIT_ID, (SELECT MIN(COMPANY_ID) COMPANY_ID, USER_ID FROM SYS_USER_ALLOCATION GROUP BY USER_ID ORDER BY USER_ID ASC) SUAC, FND_EMPLOYEE FE WHERE SUA.COMPANY_ID = FEA.COMPANY_ID AND SUA.COMPANY_ID = FOU.COMPANY_ID AND SUA.COMPANY_ID = SUAC.COMPANY_ID AND SUA.USER_ID = SUAC.USER_ID AND FE.EMPLOYEE_ID = FEA.EMPLOYEE_ID GROUP BY SUA.USER_ID, SUA.COMPANY_ID, FOU.UNIT_ID, FE.NAME ORDER BY SUA.USER_ID ASC) TABALL1 on TABALL1.user_id = arh.created_by ) t
and exists (select 1 from hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.bp_id = t.bp_id and hbm.bp_name like concat('%',concat(#{bpName},'%')))
and t.receipt_date >= to_date(#{receiptDateFrom},'YYYY-MM-DD')
and t.receipt_date <= to_date(#{receiptDateTo},'YYYY-MM-DD')
and t.business_unit like concat('%',concat(#{business_unit},'%'))
and t.business_unit like concat('%',concat(#{businessUnit},'%'))
and t.business_name like concat('%',concat(#{businessName},'%'))
order by t.receipt_date desc

SELECT cc.contract_id, ccc.cashflow_id source_id, cc.contract_number, cc.contract_name, (SELECT hbm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = cc.tenant_id ) bp_name, ccc.times, ccc.due_date, ccc.write_off_flag, ( SELECT sc.meaning FROM
sc WHERE sc.code_value = ccc.write_off_flag AND sc. CODE = 'CON.CASHFLOW_WRITE_OFF_FLAG' ) write_off_flag_desc, ccc.cf_item, ccc.cf_type, ci.description, ccc.principal, ccc.received_principal, ccc.billing_principal, ccc.billing_amount, ccc.due_amount, nvl(ccc.received_amount, 0) received_amount, cc.business_type, (select min(bp.bp_id) from hls_bp_master bp where cc.tenant_id=bp.bp_id ) bp_id, cc.currency, (select fc.currency_name from FND_CURRENCY fc where fc.currency_code = cc.currency) as currency_desc, (select sum(nvl(cwo.csh_write_off_amount,0)) from csh_write_off cwo where cwo.cashflow_id = ccc.cashflow_id and cwo.contract_id = cc.contract_id and cwo.cf_item = ccc.cf_item) csh_write_off_amount, (select cba.bank_account_num from csh_transaction csh, csh_bank_account cba where csh.bank_account_id = cba.bank_account_id and csh.transaction_id = (select max(cwo.csh_transaction_id) from csh_write_off cwo where cwo.cashflow_id = ccc.cashflow_id and cwo.contract_id = cc.contract_id and cwo.cf_item = ccc.cf_item)) bank_account_num, (select cba.bank_account_name from csh_transaction csh, csh_bank_account cba where csh.bank_account_id = cba.bank_account_id and csh.transaction_id = (select max(cwo.csh_transaction_id) from csh_write_off cwo where cwo.cashflow_id = ccc.cashflow_id and cwo.contract_id = cc.contract_id and cwo.cf_item = ccc.cf_item)) bank_account_name, (nvl(ccc.received_amount, 0) - nvl(( select round(sum(arl.amount),2) from ACR_RECEIPT_LN arl where arl.source_id = ccc.cashflow_id and arl.source_type = 'CASHFLOW_PRINCIPAL' ),0) ) as amount, (select nvl(round(sum(arl.amount),2),0) from ACR_RECEIPT_LN arl where arl.source_id = ccc.cashflow_id and arl.source_type = 'CASHFLOW_PRINCIPAL') as receive_amount FROM con_contract cc, con_contract_cashflow ccc, hls_cashflow_item ci where cc.contract_id = ccc.contract_id AND ccc.cf_item = ci.cf_item AND ccc.cf_item in(51,53) AND (ccc.received_amount - (select nvl(sum(arl.amount),0) from ACR_RECEIPT_LN arl where arl.source_id = ccc.cashflow_id and arl.source_type = 'CASHFLOW_PRINCIPAL')) > 0
and cc.contract_name like concat(concat('%',#{contractName}),'%')
and cc.contract_number like concat(concat('%',#{contractNumber}),'%')
and exists ( SELECT 1 FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = cc.tenant_id and hbm.bp_name like concat(concat('%',#{bpName}),'%'))
